speakers.description: A knight in battered plate armour, face hidden by a scarred helm, seated on the black dragon.

description.text: Wide aerial view over a burning battlefield at dusk. A huge black dragon sweeps low across the frame, wings spread wide, its dark scales catching orange firelight and red embers. A knight in battered plate armour is braced in the saddle on the dragon's back, both hands locked on the reins, cloak snapping behind. Smoke drifts in long bands over the flames, and the burning ground stretches below in patches of fire and shadow as the beast skims above the battlefield.
The huge black dragon enters low over the burning battlefield, wings extended and embers streaking past its dark hide.
Heavy wingbeats thud through the air, mixed with roaring flames and crackling fire below.
The knight in battered plate armour leans forward in the saddle, gripping the reins as the dragon skims above the fires.
Wind rushes past the riders, carrying the distant roar of the battlefield and the snap of the knight's cloak.

Medium close-up on the knight in battered plate armour as the dragon's wingbeat jolts the saddle. The helm turns toward the battle line, firelight sliding across scratched metal; the knight grips the reins and shouts a command. The dragon's neck and saddle fill the background, smoke streaking past. The tightening view presses close to the battered armour and the strain of the ride.
The shot cuts to a medium close-up of the knight's battered plate armour and scarred helm, firelight sliding across the metal.
Plate armour rattles with the jolt of the saddle, and a wingbeat buffet shakes the air.
The knight grips the reins, turns the helm toward the battle line and shouts a command into the rushing wind.
A heavy wingbeat buffets the riders while smoke and embers streak past the close view.
Firelight flickers across the knight's battered armour as the dragon's neck and saddle rise behind.

Extreme wide view as the dragon banks hard through a wall of smoke, the knight still in the saddle. The burning battlefield and the distant battle line spread far below, the fires shrinking into a vast field of embers and dark ground. Smoke curls around the pair as they climb away over the flames, the dragon's dark shape cutting upward through the glowing haze.
The dragon banks hard through a wall of smoke, its huge black shape cutting upward over the burning battlefield.
Deep wingbeats roll out over the battlefield, underlaid by roaring fire and drifting smoke.
The knight stays braced in the saddle as the dragon climbs away over the flames, the distant battle line far below.
Fire and smoke roar across the open battlefield, with a distant battle din rising from below.
The pair climb through the smoke, embers curling around them while the burning ground falls away into the distance.

soundscape: Battlefield ambience: heavy wingbeats, rushing wind, roaring flames, crackling fire, distant battle din, and rattling plate armour.
